purpose: Receipt convention for classification evaluations, so that a stored number cannot be read as a different metric, as a different population, or as a quality claim it does not carry
not_this_contract: tsl_literature_metrics.v1 is a regression MSE/MAE contract. It is not a classification contract and none of its metric names, units or reductions apply here.
field_independence: Each required field is carried explicitly. No field may be omitted and recomputed from another at read time. Consistency between fields is checked and refused on conflict; a check is not a substitute for the field.

MAP.definition: mean over evaluated rows of the average precision of the ranked label list; the benchmark's own evaluator decides the ranking and truncation

ACCURACY.definition: fraction of rows in the declared denominator whose single predicted label equals the reference label

MACRO_F1.definition: arithmetic mean over the class vocabulary of the per-class F1; every class weighs the same regardless of support

WEIGHTED_F1.definition: support-weighted mean over the class vocabulary of the per-class F1

MCC.definition: Matthews correlation coefficient over the confusion matrix

metric_confusion_rule: MAP, ACCURACY and MACRO_F1 all lie in [0,1] and are different metrics. Each carries its own metric key, its own unit token and its own metric_identity_sha256. A reader that asks a receipt for a metric it does not carry is refused by name; a comparison between two different families is refused by name. No default, no coercion, no nearest match.

paired_naive.requirement: Every author primary metric carries a paired naive of the SAME family, fitted on train labels only and scored on exactly the same evaluation rows.

policies.MAJORITY_CLASS_FROM_TRAIN: always predict the most frequent train label; ties broken by the declared label order
policies.STRATIFIED_PRIOR_FROM_TRAIN: sample labels from the train prior with a declared seed
policies.UNIFORM_OVER_VOCABULARY: uniform over the declared class vocabulary; carries no train information and must be declared as such
policies.DEVELOPMENT_FIXED_KEYWORD_RULE: a business keyword rule frozen on development data before the evaluation split was opened

paired_naive.same_rows: The naive shares the model receipt's evaluation_population_sha256. A naive scored on a different population is refused.
paired_naive.train_derived: MAJORITY_CLASS_FROM_TRAIN and STRATIFIED_PRIOR_FROM_TRAIN carry train_label_population_sha256; it must differ from evaluation_population_sha256.

class_vocabulary.rule: The ordered label list as the benchmark defines it. Truncating, reordering or merging labels is a new task, not the same task, and changes label_order_sha256.

per_class_confusion.orientation: rows are reference labels, columns are predicted labels, both in class_vocabulary order
per_class_confusion.abstention_column: an extra final column ABSTAINED counts rows the provider refused to answer

warehouse_rows.classification.support.class_<i>: reference rows of class i, unit rows
warehouse_rows.classification.predicted.class_<i>: rows predicted as class i, unit rows
warehouse_rows.classification.correct.class_<i>: rows of class i predicted as class i, unit rows
warehouse_rows.classification.abstained.class_<i>: rows of class i the provider abstained on, unit rows

per_class_confusion.full_matrix: The complete matrix lives in the receipt document and is bound by confusion_sha256. It is also placed in the terminal tag confusion_matrix_json when its canonical form is at most 8192 bytes; otherwise the tag reads CONFUSION_IN_RECEIPT_ONLY and confusion_sha256 remains the binding.
per_class_confusion.closure: sum of all confusion cells, including the ABSTAINED column, equals population.answered + population.abstained = population.total

values.NOT_PROBABILISTIC: the provider emits a label and no score
values.RANKING_SCORE_NOT_PROBABILITY: an ordered score used for ranking metrics; it is not P(label)
values.SOFTMAX_POSTERIOR_UNCALIBRATED: a normalised posterior over the vocabulary, not calibrated against observed frequency
values.SOFTMAX_POSTERIOR_TEMPERATURE_CALIBRATED: a posterior after temperature fitting on the declared calibration split
values.ISOTONIC_CALIBRATED: a posterior after isotonic fitting on the declared calibration split
values.ENTROPY_DERIVED_CONFIDENCE_NOT_P_CORRECT: a confidence built from output entropy; it is not P(correct) and may not carry NLL, Brier or ECE

probability_semantics.probability_metric_precondition: only for SOFTMAX_POSTERIOR_* semantics, with declared ece_bins and calibration_split
probability_semantics.calibrated_field: calibrated is its own boolean field and is not inferred from the semantics string; a contradiction between the two is refused

calibration_split.rule: The calibration split is kept distinct from the evaluation split. Equal split_id or equal population_sha256 is refused. calibrated true with calibration_split NONE is refused.

abstention.coverage: abstained / population.total, unit abstained_fraction; an abstention is not a prediction

denominator_policies.ANSWERED_ONLY: the primary metric's denominator is the answered rows; the receipt must carry coverage so the reader can see what was dropped
denominator_policies.FULL_POPULATION_ABSTENTION_WRONG: abstained rows count as errors in the primary metric's denominator

abstention.rule: Refusals are never removed from the denominator silently. Both the policy and the coverage are stored; a receipt missing either is refused.

corpus_classes.PUBLIC_BENCHMARK: an official published dataset and split
corpus_classes.BUSINESS_HELD_OUT: a frozen, independently held business corpus, opened under a use ledger
corpus_classes.SMOKE_FIXTURE: author-written smoke material; never a quality claim
corpus_classes.ROUTER_PROMPT_CORPUS: the internal natural-language routing corpus; it measures the router, not any classifier

router_corpus.rule: A receipt whose corpus_class is ROUTER_PROMPT_CORPUS may not carry any metric_families key at all, and may never reach a provider quality badge. 19 prompts repeated 5 times are 19 independent units, not 95 examples; repeats>1 requires independent_units and clustered_by.

evidence_classes.MEASUREMENT: produced by executing the evaluator over the declared population in this programme
evidence_classes.PUBLISHED_REFERENCE: a value read from a named paper table or result artifact; never our measured result
evidence_classes.DECLARATION: asserted by a person, a configuration or a provider without a measurement in this programme
evidence_classes.RECOUNT_OF_STORED_VERDICTS: a re-count of verdicts already stored by an earlier run; not a fresh execution
evidence_classes.TRANSPORT_TEST_NOT_SCIENCE: fabricated values exercising storage and refusal paths

declaration_marking: declared_fields lists, by name, every receipt field whose content is a declaration rather than a measurement. A receipt whose evidence_class is DECLARATION carries the whole claim as declared.

refusals.BADGE_REFUSED_ROUTER_SCORE_IS_NOT_CLASSI: the evidence is the router prompt corpus
refusals.BADGE_REFUSED_DECLARATION_IS_NOT_MEASURE: the evidence is a declaration, a recount or a published reference
refusals.BADGE_REFUSED_TRANSPORT_TEST_IS_NOT_SCIE: the evidence is a fabricated transport fixture
refusals.BADGE_REFUSED_NO_BUSINESS_CORPUS_MEASURE: no measurement on a held-out business corpus supports the claim
refusals.BADGE_REFUSED_NO_PAIRED_NAIVE: the supporting measurement carries no same-row train-derived naive

provider_quality_badge.badge_never_grants: No badge, at any value, authorises broker deployment, order placement or any execution. execution_authority is the constant NONE.

supervision_rule: If labelled rows fit a downstream head, the regime is TRAINED_HEAD_ON_FROZEN_ENCODER or FULL_FINETUNE. It is not zero-shot, even on the same test rows.
tag_encoding: every tag value is a string; metrics keep the existing nine-field governed metric schema
enforcement_scope: Producer contract for classification evaluations in this programme. The general-purpose warehouse stays generic and is not turned into a scientific verifier; nothing here rewrites historical rows or reinterprets an existing number.
published_values: A published reference value is stored as its own receipt with evidence_class PUBLISHED_REFERENCE, its source and table, and is never labelled as our measured result.
source_note: Written 2026-09-28 against CB04 and CLASSIFICATION_REFERENCE_PLAN_2026_09_28.md. Each scientific run must still pin its own dataset revision, evaluator commit, weights and protocol before any comparison exists.
